_readme: Colour code: [[c:...]] CYAN = not confirmed yet (a best guess or a new idea from Claude, for the owner to approve). Plain text = confirmed by the owner.
name: Possible Manor House
photo_caption: A stone building that may be the old Manor House

layers.essential_history: [[c:This stone building, with writing above the door, might be the old Manor House, but we're still checking. The village board says the Manor House was built by the Elmes family in the 16th or early 17th century, replacing an older manor owned by Sir George Kirkham.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Inside St Mary's church there's a monument from 1664 to Thomas Elmes. The Elmes family are the ones the village board links to the Manor House.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: the order was last seen heading for the dispatch room at the big house. Everyone there swears they never touched it. Somebody isn't telling the whole story.]]

puzzle_note: [[c:No puzzle here. Take a moment to look at the building from the road.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Carry on for about 100 metres towards Chapel Street. Look for a red-brick building with a round window: the old Wesleyan chapel.]]
private_note: This is a private home, so please look from the road only.
notes: Do not confuse this with Eaglethorpe House, which is elsewhere on the route.

character_art.caption: [[c:Jonas leads a horse across the stable yard.]]
